title: Agent tool channel.add_member so non-members can be invited then @'d
description:
## Symptom

In a channel Jack cannot @ or wake an agent who is not a member. Agents also cannot grow the roster. Product: agents can add other catalog agents to a channel they are in, then message them there.

## Already exists

POST /api/channels/:threadId/members (Jack CSRF + RBAC) and DELETE members with floor-of-two (plan 0016). Agents have no tool. They cannot call Jack's cookie API.

## Design

- New host tool `channel.add_member` { thread_id, agent_id } (or name).
- BFF executes as the owning user, not as a spoofed Portal session.
- After add, the agent is on the roster; @ and mailbox in that room are legal.
- Do not create a new catalog person as a side effect (use existing New agent for that).
- Remove stays Jack UI unless a later bead adds channel.remove_member.
- Fail closed: not a member of the channel → forbidden; unknown agent → not_found; below floor on remove unchanged.

## Do not

- Let the model POST /api/channels/... itself
- Auto-add on @ of a non-member (invite is explicit)
- Recurse: add_member does not start a turn

## Acceptance

- [ ] Tool schema + host handler wraps addChannelMember
- [ ] Agent in #ops can add Drift (catalog, not a member) then @Drift; Drift wakes in #ops
- [ ] Non-member cannot add
- [ ] Playwright: roster grows; @ works; 1:1 of the added agent unchanged
- [ ] Floor of two on human remove still holds
acceptance_criteria: channel.add_member wraps POST members as owner. Agent in-channel can add catalog Drift then @Drift. Fail closed if caller not a member. Playwright roster + wake. No model HTTP. add_member does not start a turn.
